page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 24 vCPUs (12 physical cores with 2 threads per core) running at 2.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 186.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.75 GB of RAM per core. It includes 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 4 local SSDs, but does not feature any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data highlights strong single-core capabilities, with Geekbench single-core scores and single-threaded gzip compression (36.68 GB/sec) and bzip3 decompression (15.42 GB/sec) ranking in the top tier. Multi-core performance is also robust, with Geekbench multi-core scores and image processing benchmarks placing in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is measured at 2024.01 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 153.52 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. The CPU supports advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512, which accelerate vector and matrix operations.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and integrated high-speed local NVMe SSD storage, this server offers a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive and storage-bound workloads. It is appropriate for hosting databases, executing data processing pipelines, running memory-cached applications like Redis, and performing software compilation or text processing tasks. The inclusion of local NVMe SSDs provides low-latency storage access, making it a viable option for workloads that require fast temporary storage without the overhead of network-attached disks.
